FINAL: Boston Celtics 119, Charlotte Hornets 80

🏀 Jayson Tatum: 34 PTS, 8 REB, 9 AST, 1 STL, 1 BLK.

#BleedGreen

https://wire.report/live/401909288?utm_source=bluesky&utm_medium=mirror&utm_content=nba

The Boston Celtics hit 24 threes tonight…

33 ASSISTS ON 38 MADE FIELD GOALS.

19-23 from the free throw line.

49 bench points.

39 point road victory.

The Celtics crushed Charlotte behind a 34/8/9 masterclass from Tatum in just 29 minutes and a whole 4th quarter of rest. The Celtics needed a shooting night like this. Here's instant reaction & a bonus podcast coming up in a little bit.

Jayson Tatum:

"I always love playing here. It's like one of my second to thrid homes being back in North Carolina. A lot of Celtics obviously, a lot of Duke fans, I got a lot of family connections out here so I love coming back here"
